headline: Nick Bosa suffers a multi-week calf injury
summary: Ian Rapoport provides an update on Nick Bosa's practice-related injury ahead of San Francisco's game vs. Arizona.

headline: Sources: Giants' Jaxson Dart scheduled for left knee surgery Friday
summary: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart is scheduled to undergo surgery Friday on his left knee, sources told ESPN. The belief is it will be a meniscus and MCL repair.

headline: Jets' No. 1 TE Mason Taylor (thumb) out vs. high-scoring Lions
summary: The Jets will be without No. 1 tight end Mason Taylor (thumb) and safety Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) when they face the Detroit Lions on Sunday.

headline: LT Josh Simmons out, CB Mansoor Delane set to play for Chiefs-Dolphins
summary: The Chiefs are once again set to start undrafted rookie Kahlil Benson at left tackle.

headline: Dan Campbell: Jets hiring Aaron Glenn was one of the best and worst days of my life
summary: Lions head coach Dan Campbell and Jets head coach Aaron Glenn were both born and raised in Texas, both played at Texas A&M, they were teammates on the Cowboys, they were on the Saints' coaching staff together for five years, and when Campbell got the Detroit job, making Glenn his defensive coordinator was his first order of business.

headline: Nick Chubb retires with Browns ahead of game-day honor
summary: Nick Chubb returned to Cleveland to officially retire as a member of the Browns, calling it "better closure" after his exit from the team following the 2024 season.
